name: youtube-mcp
description: Create playlists from song lists with OAuth2. Search videos, manage playlists, let AI curate your YouTube collections.
long_description: A powerful YouTube integration that enables Claude to search videos, create and manage playlists, and help curate your YouTube content. Features OAuth2 authentication for secure access to your YouTube account, allowing full playlist management capabilities beyond read-only operations.

tools.name: add_to_playlist
tools.description: Add a video to a playlist

tools.description: List user playlists with pagination tokens and page metadata
